title: One SDK for generation requests
summary:
A new cross-platform SDK arrived while accounts, model names, token counts, and dashboard stats got less confusing.

Added @pollinations/sdk 4.0.1 for Node.js and browsers, covering image, video, text, chat, and audio generation plus model lists. It brings streaming, conversation and batch helpers, typed responses, retries, and timeouts. This replaces the old React package; its hooks are not part of the new SDK.

The legacy auth page now directs people to Enter for accounts and tokens instead of offering registration, login, or token management there. It also clarifies that anonymous API calls still work.

Text-generation validation now accepts model aliases from the shared registry. Kimi uses `kimi` as its service ID while retaining `kimi-k2-thinking` and `kimi-k2` as aliases. A gateway update also corrects Gemini thought-token accounting in downstream analytics.

daily.title: One SDK, more modalities
daily.text: Use `@pollinations/sdk` from Node.js or the browser for image, video, text, chat, audio, and model-list requests. It includes streaming, conversation and batch helpers; the former React hooks are not included. [View the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).
